summary: Kelso Technologies filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a Canadian interim-report package) carrying its Q3 2026 news release, IFRS interim financial statements, MD&A and CEO/CFO 52-109F2 certifications for the period ended September 30, 2026. Results showed revenue of $1,756,751 for the quarter and $5,751,306 for nine months, gross profit of 30% and 33%, operating expenses down to $954,240, and equity of $3,569,211 with no term debt plus $500,000 drawn on a $1,000,000 revolver. No transaction, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed; a routine periodic report, not a special situation.
